_design: Dense vertical timing chain. Jump cleanly under vine, land precisely on sinking log mid-air-low (vine is at the height you'd reach if you held jump), immediately jump again before sink. Slime at exit punishes a player who held the jump or stalled on the log. Two essence: one between vine and log (jump arc apex), one on the log itself (only if you landed correctly).
